title: Potentially the worst ever app update
body:
The launching of the new NBD X app should be a case study in how not to put your customers first.

This app is clearly not fit for purpose, especially when compared to the previous solid and excellent version.

I am now unable to make international transfers, consistently receiving “transaction failed” errors at some point after receiving confirmation. The problem is I’ve no idea when as you don’t receive any message to tell you status has now changed to failed.

There are so many extra steps to the consumer journey that it’s genuinely amazing this was ever released as fit for customer use.  E.g. to receive a smart pass pin, you must log in through 2 stages (this will take 3 attempts), click through to “my messages”, scroll through to “my activities” then click into the message. Its such a small example of a lagging app compared to best-in-class versions.  I will never understand why this app version was released for general use.

title: "Gratitude Unveiled: Reflecting on Exceptional Service and Appreciating the Difference."
body:
Dear ENBD Team,

Greetings with heartfelt thanks! 

I would like to express my sincere appreciation and satisfaction with ENBD Bank's offline, online, and direct services. The customer service has been consistently excellent, with knowledgeable and helpful representatives. The sales team has demonstrated professionalism, and transactions are processed with impressive speed and accuracy. One notable aspect is the trustworthiness of ENBD, as I have not encountered any hidden charges in credit or loan dealings.

I appreciate the consideration given to permanent customers, including the waiver of limit exceeding and over-limit fees for unintentional delays. In comparison with four other reputable banks, I find that ENBD stands out, especially as I use five credit cards, and ENBD is the only bank providing all the mentioned benefits.

I want to extend my gratitude to the entire team at ENBD for their great consideration, help, support, assurance, and assistance. Looking forward to continued excellent service.

"ENBD Team, thanks! - Every individual's contribution is valued and makes a difference!"

Truthfully & Sincerely,

Salmanul Faris 
0543520321

(Reason for the review :- "THANK YOU, AND I APOLOGIZE FOR THE DELAYED APPRECIATION REVIEW. EXPERIENCING THE SERVICE OF OTHER FIRMS HAS MADE ME TRULY APPRECIATE AND ACKNOWLEDGE THE QUALITY OF YOUR SERVICE. I AM GENUINELY GRATEFUL FOR YOUR EXCEPTIONAL SERVICE.")

title: Title: Frustrating Apple Pay Integration for ENBD Bank Cards
body:
I am writing this review to express my dissatisfaction with the ENBD X Banking app's Apple Pay integration for ENBD bank cards. Despite submitting a complaint to customer support, I have not received any positive response or a solution to my problem. Moreover, my complaint was automatically marked as completed, even though the issue remains unresolved.

The main issue I encountered is the inability to connect my ENBD credit card, debit card, and NBD Liv card to Apple Pay. While I understand that technology can sometimes have its complexities, it is disappointing to see that other bank cards can seamlessly integrate with Apple Pay without any issues.

As an Apple user, I looked forward to utilizing the convenience of Apple Pay to make secure and effortless transactions, but unfortunately, I have been unable to fully enjoy this feature due to the app's shortcomings.

The lack of a satisfactory response or a resolution from customer support further adds to my frustration. As a banking app user, I believe that excellent customer service should be a top priority, especially when customers face technical difficulties.

I urge the team behind ENBD X Banking app to address this issue as a matter of urgency. It is crucial to rectify the Apple Pay integration problem for ENBD bank cards, as this directly impacts the overall user experience and convenience of the app.

I hope that this review catches the attention of the management of ENBD X Banking, and prompt action is taken to resolve the Apple Pay integration issue for ENBD bank cards. It is important to ensure that customers can fully utilize the app's features and enjoy a seamless banking experience.

Thank you for taking the time to read my review, and I hope that my feedback contributes to the improvement of the ENBD X Banking app.

body: It seems like you're expressing frustration with the new version of a service. To provide feedback effectively, you might consider writing a clear and concise email outlining the specific issues you've encountered. You can structure it like this: Subject: Feedback on New Version of [Service Name] 1. **Direct Remittance:** In the previous version, I found the process of making direct remittances straightforward and user-friendly. However, in the new version, I am facing difficulties navigating through the steps and completing the transaction smoothly. Old beneficiaries are missing in this new version 2. **Adding Beneficiaries:** Adding beneficiaries used to be a simple process that allowed me to manage my account efficiently. With the new version, I find that the beneficiary management feature is not as intuitive and requires more effort to accomplish. 3. **Overall Experience:** While I understand the need for updates, the current version has become a source of frustration for me and, I believe, for other users as well. author: Mundachali Rahul

reply.body: Good Afternoon! We strongly advice all our customers not to share their security access credentials with anyone. Bank will never ask for card numbers, CVV and PINs. Your security is our top priority, and we take these incidents very seriously. Rest assured that our banking application is designed with stringent security controls to protect your personal and financial information. title: Terrible upgrade
body:
My previous review was missing for some reason. Cut the story short. Issues I was facing after upgrading to ENBD X are the following.

1. Credit card cashback redeem is no longer available.
2. Few of my local/ international transfer are missing.
3. I forgot the last one.

After seeing my review. Someone from ENBD called me and offered a 200AED gift card as a compensation which my wife truly enjoyed spending in Carrefour.

End of September seems to have an “EXCITING UPGRADE” but the fact remains that my previous issue are still the same. If you are using the old ENBD app.

Please continue to use it as this app has a lot of work needs to be done.

I recently discovered also using the scheduled transfer is a total failure. Tried setting a schedule transfer to my another bank but to my surprised it was deducted on the same day instead of next month.

When are you planning to return the credit card cashback option? Consumer like us is wasting a lot of time listening to automated voice messages before we can really speak to an actual person just because we want to redeem a cashback.
author: Mackers214

reply.body:

title: Application Review: Highly Disappointing User Experience
body: I am extremely dissatisfied with this application and would rate it below zero if such a rating were possible. The user interface is exceptionally challenging to navigate, resulting in confusion and frustration. The lack of clear indications regarding account locations further compounds the difficulties. Moreover, the limited options provided by the application add to the overall frustration. I have also encountered issues where certain accounts are not visible during the transfer process. Comparatively, the previous version of the application was significantly better. Due to the shortcomings of this current version, I have contemplated changing banks. However, attempting to revert to the old application has proven futile as I receive a message stating that I cannot download it because I have already installed the new version. This restriction feels like a punishment, and I cannot comprehend the reasoning behind the modifications or support provided by the IT team for this aggravating "Application xNbad." Unless improvements are made or the previous version is reinstated, it appears as though the bank may inadvertently drive customers away in search of a more cooperative institution with better IT services.

reply.body: Hi, thank you for reaching out to us. Direct Debit  can be set-up by clicking on Cards section - Details - scroll down to Repayment Terms - then click on Set Direct Debit to repay your credit card. Then you can choose from which account to debit from, Minimum monthly percentage and click on 'Save'.  Alternatively, you may click on 'Explore' and type in search field "Direct" which will take you to the same process to set-up. To pay multiple bills, click on 'Transfer/Pay' tab - Pay Bills - click on 'Pay multiple bills' and then choose which bills you want to pay at one go.  Scroll down to see credit card then click on it to see card summary details and all detailed information of your credit card will show. title: Revolutionizing Digital Banking: The Artistry of Emirates NBD X
body:
The Emirates NBD X app is a harmonious blend of aesthetics and functionality, a symphony of digital banking that has transformed my financial management experience. The app’s design is a testament to the beauty of simplicity, with an intuitive user interface that makes navigation a breeze.
Every service is seamlessly integrated into the UI, making it feel like a natural extension of my daily life. Whether it’s transferring funds, paying bills, or checking account balances, every feature is just a tap away. The app’s smooth performance further enhances the user experience, ensuring that every interaction is swift and satisfying.
But what truly sets ENBD X apart is its artistry. It’s not just an app - it’s a masterpiece of digital design. The attention to detail is evident in every pixel, reflecting a deep understanding of user needs and a commitment to excellence.
Emirates NBD X isn’t just an app; it’s a revolution in digital banking. It sets the bar high for what a banking app should be - intuitive, efficient, and aesthetically pleasing. Thank you, Emirates NBD, for this work of art that makes banking a pleasure.

title: A Seamless Banking Experience
body:
I recently had the opportunity to explore the Emirates Islamic mobile banking application, and I must say that I am thoroughly impressed with the overall user experience and functionality it offers. As a new customer to Emirates Islamic Bank, this app has certainly elevated my banking experience to new heights.

From the moment I downloaded the app, I was greeted with a clean and user-friendly interface. The home screen provides easy access to all the essential banking features, making it incredibly convenient to manage my finances on the go. Whether it's checking my account balance, transferring funds, or paying bills, the app offers a wide range of services that cover all my banking needs.

One of the standout features for me is the app's robust security measures. EI has clearly invested in state-of-the-art security protocols, ensuring that my personal and financial information remains protected. The biometric login options provide an extra layer of security that gives me peace of mind when using the app.

Another aspect that sets the Emirates Islamic mobile app apart is its responsiveness and speed. Transactions are processed swiftly, and I can easily view my account history and pending transactions without any lag. This level of efficiency is crucial in today's fast-paced world, and Emirates Islamic bank has certainly delivered on this front.

title: Need Enhancement
body:
I’ve recently upgraded to the ENBD X app. I’ve few comments: 
1) the function to set daily transaction limits for credit card is missing. It’s available only for the debit card. It was available on previous app. I hope to bring it to the new app as well. 
2) on viewing the transactions made in the account. I can see only the amounts of transactions without the account balance next to it. Hope to be able to see account balance next to each transaction made to be able spot transaction recording and how it reflected in the account. 
3) colors and font need to be reconsidered. It is very light and difficult to read.
4) the instructions given doesn’t match the actual steps on the app. Ie. in some places saying “go to hamburger menu”, which I can’t find such menu on the app, also the FAQ informing about setting daily transaction limits is not clear and confusing 
5) previous app was more user friendly. Since it’s still active we should be given the choice to use it, or you may make the upgrade mandatory and shift all users to new app. It’s sad the I was given the option to upgrade and not given the same option to move back
6) There are lots of enhancements needed for the new app especially the design and functionality of the app. Hope to look at it keeping the previous app functions as baseline.
Thank you.

All my saved beneficiaries are incorrect and need to update the list all over again. The new app seems to be heavy because it’s way too slow compared to the old one considering I am using a very new IPhone 14 Pro Max. Keeps on lagging and crashing.

title: Failure upgrad
body:
After upgrading to the latest version of this App, I've encountered a series of issues:

1- The app inaccurately reports errors in beneficiary details and prompts for their updates. Regardless, these problems persist. Alarmingly, I can't re-add any beneficiaries once removed, effectively making them neither existent nor deleted. Despite reaching out to support, this issue remains unresolved.

2- I encountered an uncooperative support representative who refused to log my complaint. She asserted that it's impossible to lodge complaints against the App, which is quite surprising.

3- The app is generally not user-friendly. Issues include tiny font size and inadequate visualization tools.

In my personal experience, this app upgrade has been a failure.

title: Don’t download this app
body:
If I can give this app zero stars I would ! Be careful the moment you download it you are automatically blocked from using the old app. And here is the worst part: they will lock you from smart pass and ask you to update it by using a mobile number. In my case it was inactive number, and I can’t update it because I was supposed to do it in the old app ! How creative ? Also the only clowny solution this bank has to offer is to go to their branch personally to update the mobile number : what a service ? I should jump on a plane, cut my vacations to do the online banking ?

title: Miss Sold Emirates Skywards Card
body:
Hi there, 

I would like to make a formal complaint about being miss sold my Emirates Skywards Credit Card.
Shahnawaz Khan who works in your Al Barsha branch, came to my villa and got me to sign all documents.

He advised me that there was a sign up charge of 1500AED. I was extremely shocked to find that my first statement there was a charge of 2999AED + VAT!

He said he has been trying to resolve this situation with his boss Ronald, however this has gone on over 2 months now!

I would have never signed up for this card if I knew that the joining fee was 2999AED!

Regards

Stephen Mackey

title: Horrible App
body:
It’s a horrendously done app. I’ll be prescriptive about  feedback so if anyone reads this, I am hoping they’ll work on the fix. 

— Pre-auth charges are committed as transactions in the app. They give you a feeling that you have already paid and the clock ticks on the interest. Balance hold is ok, but committing the transaction isn’t. 

— Transfer service to your own account only works for savings and current. If you open a flexi deposit account, they don’t come as transferable which it is, in its product feature. 

— Tech support has absolutely no idea if you call them regarding a bug or a clarification. They aren’t trained on this app. 

— Changing transfer limits, after authorisation and security Pin, changes back without notice to default. Catches you by surprise. 

— Service requests are open for ever and they don’t close / resolve even when you call the Priority Banking service and they say it’s closed. 

This is an app that isn’t ready for use. Not even as a Beta. I can’t seem to use the old app for some reasons. 

Don’t download this!!!!!!

title: Not fit for purpose
body:
I recently downloaded the Emirates NBD banking app and I have to say, it is not fit for purpose. It is slow, clunky, and incredibly frustrating to use. I wish I could go back to using the old app, which was much more user-friendly and efficient.

First of all, the app takes forever to load, and even when it does finally open, it is incredibly slow to navigate. Trying to check my account balance or transfer money between accounts takes forever, and I often find myself having to restart the app multiple times just to get it to work properly.

The app is also full of bugs and glitches. I have had multiple instances where transactions were not showing up in my account, or where the app would freeze and I would have to force close it and start over.

Overall, I am incredibly disappointed with the Emirates NBD banking app. It is not up to the standards that I would expect from a major bank, and I would strongly advise anyone considering using it to look elsewhere.

title: Issue with session handling
body:
Sorry to say but you guys have an issue with the session expiration . Once the session is expired, probably your not being able to successfully share the refresh token with backend to have a new one but you still have the app logged in with empty values (Amount, accounts,etc). You can see the UI but it is crashes as there are no values . 
Apart from the previous issue, as a front end engineer I like the new UX. I feel it has now a new out-of-the-box look and feel but still very intuitive in tue banking context and I appreciate it does not feel the same as the average bank app. Animations as as expected but interactions feels good in the fingers and eyes. 
From the UI I like how components are presented: the spacing is simply accurate to match the UI, the color pallete is simple but fresh, the dividers are well placed (usually hard to implement well) and the background color is not the usual but this experiment feels fantastic to my eyes . 
Backend services are responding fast. You probably do not need my review but just wanted to say congrats .
I would love to give you 5 stars so please fix the issues.

title: Me
body:
Same bugs as the previous App — no real improvements just the face change. Some of the better look improvements are nicer but also misleading:
— you cannot understand your total balance, transactions are uploaded with delay so you never see your actual balance immediately  or even an hour after spent/received money 
— no info on total spend per account per month to help plan the budget (elementary thing many banks offer)
— for deposit products not clear what is the offered rate — you suggest applying for account opening without letting know what is actual % you promise to client
— sliding thing on the right looks nice but not clear why it is there — totally dysfunctional thing (why to clog the space with this?)
— ordering statements — ordered bank verified statement through the app, got message thy the statement is ready but where to get it remains unknown, have to write to support to find out (some strange partial service — better simply write — “go to bank branch and get your statement”, at least no wasted time hoping service actually works)

And, dear NBD team, writing in reply to a review “write us an email and we will resolve” is not at all professional—better tell your customers when and how you will test the App properly and fix its distinctions. 
Reviews are written here already — read them, act on them, and do not request additional emails and don’t steal time of your clients for this unnecessary communication please.

Thank you — hope to see real improvements soon.

title: A Disastrous Banking App Migration: Missing Features and Frustrations Galore
body:
I have been a loyal customer of Emirates NBD Bank for several years now, relying on their old banking app for my financial needs. However, my experience took a nosedive when the bank decided to migrate to a new app that promised improvements and enhanced features. Unfortunately, what was supposed to be an upgrade turned out to be a major disappointment.
One of the most glaring issues with the new banking app is the complete absence of the Excel download format. In the previous app, I could effortlessly export my transactions to an Excel spreadsheet for personal record-keeping and analysis. It was a convenient feature that helped me manage my finances effectively. But to my dismay, the new app offers no such functionality. Why would the bank remove such a crucial feature without any reasonable explanation? It's mind-boggling and extremely frustrating.

Another baffling omission is the lack of customized date selections for statements. In the old app, I had the flexibility to choose specific date ranges for generating my bank statements. This allowed me to track my expenses and income during particular periods. However, in the new app, I'm limited to predefined date ranges, and there's no option to select a custom range. It's incredibly inconvenient and makes it challenging to analyze my financial activities accurately.

Furthermore, the absence of credit card statement selection is another major setback. The previous app allowed me to access my credit card statements with ease, helping me monitor my spending, track rewards, and review transaction details. Sadly, the new app disregards this essential feature altogether. It's astonishing that the bank would eliminate such a crucial function, leaving credit card users in the dark about their financial status.

Overall, the migration from the old banking app to the new one has been nothing short of a disaster. The removal of key features like the Excel download format, customized date selections for statements, and credit card statement access has significantly hindered my ability to manage my finances effectively. It feels like the bank failed to consider the needs and preferences of its customers during the app development process.

I sincerely hope that ENBD Bank takes immediate action to rectify these glaring oversights and reintroduce the missing features. Until then, I would strongly advise against using the new banking app, as it fails to meet even the basic requirements for a satisfactory user experience.

There’s been no reason given to manage the change to the new app.  Previous app was great - easily searchable history for payments, easy to find a particular payee in history.  This new app allows for none of that and you have to trawl through statements trying to find payments. 
If you want to get people to like the new app, tell them why the change is necessary and listen to the feedback of the functions we want, or explain why you’re deprecating them.

title: Worst App update ever
body:
The old app was convenient and user friendly with all functionalities available to self serve. I have faced multiple problems since I was forced to move to this app. Started with compromising my credentials which resulted in applying for all new cards and if that was not enough this crap app doesn't let me do basic job. One of the best automation Bank has become old age stupid bank. I will move my credit card to another bank because of this useless app.

It doesn't do following basic job:
- Fund transfer requires adding beneficiaries again.
- doesn't let you convert installment transactions. 
- Mepay is no longer smooth
- You can't convert your credit card points into payment of credit card
- overall UI is not very thoughtful
author: viral17

reply.body:
Hi, thank you for sharing your feedback. Kindly be advised that if you have gone thru migration from the old app to the new app, all your existing beneficiaries will be transferred as well.  However, if you have downloaded the app from the store and registered directly, then you will need to add beneficiaries again.  Converting transactions into installments is still available as well as Mepay. Click on 'Transfer/Pay - Mobile number' then you may 'Transfer to new mobile number' or search from your current beneficiaries from the list.  For conversion of points, this feature will available October end. Take advantage of redeeming your points with 1point = 1AED by doing instant redemption with participating stores.  Whereas with cashback, it's 1 Plus Point = 0.75 AED only.

Please consider rerating the App. Thank you for banking with Emirates NBD.

title: The app is very glitchy, most features don't work properly
body: I recently tried using this app, and unfortunately, it has been a very frustrating experience. The app is extremely glitchy and often crashes, which makes it very difficult to use. Additionally, I was disappointed that it lacks the smart pass feature from the previous app, which is still required to log in for web banking. This has made my banking experience less efficient and has caused a major inconvenience. Furthermore, the messaging for support feature doesn’t seem to function properly, and there are also issues with viewing statements and reward points on the web banking platform. I hope the developers address these issues soon, as it is impacting my overall satisfaction with this app.
author: Mridul Bhandari

reply.body:
Hi Mridul, thank you for reaching out to us. Smart pass icon will no longer show as Smart Pass PIN is only required while authorizing transactions thru push notifications received. You may also see in the app a 'slider in blue color' from the right part of the screen and where you may see the pending authorization/s such as confirming your web banking login. You may contact us through the app by accessing our enhanced messaging center by Click on "Services" tab from the bottom menu bar, scroll down to see "Messaging - click on New Message - Create new request" and our team will get back to you at the earliest! You can access your credit card rewards statements by clicking on the credit card - below the card image click on the points showing and it will take you to Reward points details.


Please consider rerating the App. Thank you for banking with Emirates NBD.

Current accounts:

- Not possible to select certain period to look for transactions within this period. The alternative solution is downloading separate statements per each month
- When you download a statement for a certain month, the downloaded statement in not for the same selected month
Credit cards account:
- the transactions appear with categories (e.g. Retail Purchase). You need to open each transaction separately to know the name of the shop
- the transactions that are eligible for instalment are not highlighted
- when you request instalment, the application just not respond

The app is not updating its information properly. When I finally managed to “find” my credit cards. I proceeded to pay my outstanding balance on it. After making the payment (which was smoother and just easier on the old app), the debt balance was still showing on my card and still is now, after taking  quite some time to write this review.

title: This is a horrible app.
body:
The app isn’t easy to play with. Plus it doesn’t have the function that the old app had. 
I am trying to transfer my money from all the accounts that I have and I keep getting the message saying “Error” the account selected is not eligible for this transaction. Please visit the nearest branch. or Failure We had a problem while processing your request. The account selected is not eligible for this transition. Please visit the nearest branch. I went to the beach nome of the staff knew what was happening. The only thing the were saying was sorry. I called the call center, same story the don’t know what is happening. It’s more than one week. I can’t even pay my credit card. Tomorrow is my birthday and I cannot even go for a trip because I am scared of not being able to use my debit card. The funny thing is how a bank in the U.A.E that says this is the city of the future cannot even solve a small app issue? 
That’s why so many people are changing for other banks and I will make sure to share what’s happening to me, to make sure so other people don’t get the same stress. Plus I keep getting messages saying my problem has being solved which it wasn’t. I was waiting for them to call me back. But I didn’t get any call from the with any solution. It’s very disrespectful and unprofessional with the clients not being able to even transfer or do anything with their money.

1) All my sync with financial applications are down, because of the two-factor auth that cannot be overridden for some apps. Do you think creating “app token” with read-only access might be a good idea for integration with external systems? Same as in modern email services or Apple Dev

2) Total balance is calculated wrong when you have mixed currencies;

3) I need export to CSV at least, because of 1) - and I have only export to PDF.

4) Please, implement something like a basic analytics: spends per type, monthly. Otherwise there are no benefits with the previous app.

The only good thing about new app: improved security, but visibility of what’s going on with transactions, quality of dashboards, and integrations are total mess

body:
Used to transfer money instantly, now they initiate the process and transfer happens after hours (western union transfer)

The transferred amount doesn’t show now immediately as before in transaction history and also doesn’t get deducted from the available balance until it is done. So if you are transferring to multiple credit cards and transactions will happen the next next, you will not actually know what would the actual available remaining balance until the next next. Old app was different.

Old app was much better in all ways, from navigating to showing details. I wish i never moved to this what is said new service.
